title: Maven multi-module reactor
expected: Use the native parent/modules/dependency graph once.
Associate library and app jars plus Surefire reports with their modules.
Expose implicit lint and read-only formatting checks; explicit format may rewrite sources, but build never does.

cases.name: native-reports
cases.change: Apply the app POM and AppIT.java overrides in variants/reporting.
cases.expect: Retain all Surefire/Failsafe XML from native custom directories, coverage and snapshot artifacts without Oyzu report configuration.

cases.name: integration-failure
cases.change: Change the expected greeting in AppIT.java.
cases.expect: Preserve the failed integration-test report and collect no artifacts.

cases.name: integration-only
cases.change: Remove AppTest.java from the reporting variation.
cases.expect: Collect successful Failsafe evidence without requiring nonexistent Surefire XML for that module.

cases.name: shared-code-change
cases.expect: Re-test the consuming app through the reactor graph.

cases.name: lint-failure
cases.change: Add an unused java.util.Random import to an application source file.
cases.expect: Native compilation/tests can succeed, but lint fails, artifacts are blocked, test evidence is retained and source stays unchanged.

cases.name: format-failure
cases.change: Add an extra space between public and class in an application source file.
cases.expect: Read-only formatting fails and blocks artifacts without changing source; explicit oyzu run format can repair it.

limitations: Oyzu CLI/build/agent integration is pending; native checks do not prove policy, sandbox, cache, reporting, or release behavior.
